arabic text: GHUSTAKON KAY HAJOOM MAIN - ZAINAB THI DARMIYAN
english translation text: IN THE MIDST OF INSOLENT CROWD –ZAINAB WAS ENTRAPPED

arabic text: HAIRAAN HUN BAZAAR SAY –\nKAISAY GUZAR GAYI\nTATHEER KI PAALI THI - BAZAAR KA SAMAA
english translation text: I AM AZAMED THAT HOW DID SHE PASS TROUGH THE BAZAAR\nSHE GREW UP IN SHADOW OF CHAADAR OF HIJAB

arabic text: YEH SOCH KAY SAJAAD KA - DIL KHOON RO PARA\nTAFSEER BAYRIDA THI - NEZAY PAY THA QURAN
english translation text: SAJAAD’S HEART CRIED TEARS OF BLOOD AS HE SAW\nQURAN WAS ON THE SPEARHEAD AND BIBI WAS UNVEILED

arabic text: KAISAY UTHAYE LAASH KO - MAZLOOM CHALDIYE\nTAUQEER KI ZAIFI - AKBAR SA NOJAWAN
english translation text: I WONDER HOW HE PICKED UP THE BODY OF AKBAR\nHE WAS OLD AND SAD AND AKBAR WAS YOUTHFUL

arabic text: KYUN BAAR BAAR LETAY HO - TUM NAAM BALWA AAM MAIN\nMAAR JAYE GI BAZAAR MAIN - HAYE AAJ MERI MAA
english translation text: WHY DO YOU CALL OUT THE NAME – IN THIS COMMON CROWD\nMY MOTHER WILL DIE OF SHAME IN THIS BAZAAR

arabic text: FAKHRAY KHALEEL TERI YE HIMMAT KO HAI SALAM\nPHAL KHENCHNA PISAAR KA - HOTA NAHIN ASAAN
english translation text: O PRIDE OF IBRAHIM WE SALUTE YOUR COURAGE\nHOW DIFFICULT WAS IT TO PULL THE SPEAR FROM THE CHEST

arabic text: YASRAB SAY JO AMEER CHALA - THA ASHUR KO KARBAL MAIN WOH LUTA HAY - RISALAT KA KARWAN
english translation text: AMEER THE CARAVAN THAT LEFT FROM YASRAB- ON ASHURA\nIT WAS LOOTED IN KARBALA- THE PROGENY OF PROPHET
